# German Autobahn sign fixtures

`regensburg.json` and `ingolstadt.json`: the motorway / trunk ways and links within 5 km of the benchmark junctions
(A3 Neutraubling, Kreuz Regensburg A3 / A93; A9 Lenting, Dreieck Holledau), their nodes and the tags the sign-shard
builder reads, from the Overpass API on 2026-11-08 (the motorway_junction nodes' tags on 2026-11-09), trimmed for
`test_de_autobahn_golden.py`.
